hypothesis: Maintain a fresh task-local CVT-MAP-Elites archive whose fixed task-agnostic descriptor cells each hold at most one oracle-evaluated molecule, choose occupied cells uniformly without global score-rank weighting, and generate every proposal de novo from their elites by sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation. Map returned offspring back through the same frozen tessellation and let each compete only with the incumbent of its own cell, so structurally distinct cell elites remain eligible to produce descendants even when they fall outside a same-capacity global top-score population.
method_thesis: For each independent objective session, place only the ten fixed oracle-evaluated starting molecules into a fresh MAP-Elites archive whose cells are a small fixed centroidal Voronoi tessellation of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors. Draw occupied cells rather than globally ranked molecules, use their evaluated elites as parents for sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation, and submit only novel valid offspring constructed de novo. After oracle feedback, map each accepted offspring to its descriptor cell and replace that cell's occupant only when the returned score is higher. Cell-local competition preserves structurally different stepping stones that a single global elite population would discard, while every cell still optimizes the same task reward and the global incumbent across the archive remains the sole terminal Top-1 target. The unlabeled corpus may define descriptor ranges or mutation fragments but is never scored, retrieved, ranked, or treated as a candidate pool; archive coverage and diversity are mechanism evidence rather than benchmark objectives.

activation_observables.measurement: Record the immutable descriptor-transform and centroid hashes loaded by each objective session and, for every initial or accepted canonical molecule, its descriptor vector, normalized vector, nearest-centroid identifier, and distance; report the fraction assigned reproducibly to exactly one cell plus initial and post-feedback occupied-cell counts and coverage relative to a zero-archive baseline.
activation_observables.name: fixed_cvt_assignment_and_coverage

activation_observables.measurement: Before every parent draw, record the complete occupied-cell set and declared probability of every eligible cell, then report the maximum absolute deviation and total-variation distance from the uniform distribution over those cells, together with aggregate realized draw counts; the registered reference is fully concentrated selection with positive deviation.
activation_observables.name: occupied_cell_sampling_probability_deviation

activation_observables.measurement: For every accepted scored offspring, record its assigned cell, that cell's incumbent identifier and score before feedback, the insertion or rejection decision, its incumbent after feedback, and hashes of all non-target cells; report the fraction of transitions that insert into an empty cell or replace an occupied cell if and only if the offspring score is strictly higher while leaving every other cell unchanged.
activation_observables.name: cell_local_replacement_fidelity

activation_observables.measurement: After each archive update, form a telemetry-only global top-K reference from all oracle-evaluated molecules where K equals the occupied-cell count, and report the count and fraction of actual cell incumbents outside that reference, how many remain parent-eligible, how many are subsequently selected, and how many emitted offspring descend from them; a global elitist population provides the zero-retention reference and must not drive proposals.
activation_observables.name: non_global_elite_retention_and_use

activation_observables.measurement: For every occupied-cell collision, report the offspring-minus-incumbent oracle-score difference, whether the local incumbent changed, and the resulting best score in that cell; aggregate the number, fraction, and mean positive score gain of replacements separately from empty-cell insertions.
activation_observables.name: within_cell_oracle_quality_gain

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique sanitized canonical offspring emitted per raw graph-operator attempt and the fraction traceable to evaluated cell elites, sampled parent-cell identifiers, and at least one successful crossover or positional mutation, with separate counts for sanitization failures, unchanged products, evaluated or prior-emission collisions, and within-batch collisions, plus whether the announced batch was filled.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_cell_elite_offspring_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus spans enough physicochemical descriptor variation to define a stable task-agnostic CVT, and the fixed initial molecules plus generated offspring can be assigned to it without task-specific fitting.

The initial panel or early valid offspring occupy multiple cells, and subsequent edits create enough occupied-cell collisions to exercise both niche preservation and within-cell score competition during the 300-call session.
Useful high-scoring descendants are reachable by sanitized graph crossover and positional atom, bond, ring, or fragment analogue edits from oracle-evaluated archive incumbents.
Oracle scores vary within at least some cells so strict local replacement can retain improvements while lower-global-rank incumbents in other cells remain viable stepping stones.

Graph-operator validity and novelty remain high enough to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit; seed-0 evidence from node n-5a4d65146dd1 supports these emitter primitives but does not establish the CVT archive mechanism.

The fixed cell count balances coverage and reuse within 290 adaptive calls; the method may underperform when the optimum lies in one narrow niche and uniform occupied-cell allocation diverts calls, when descriptor proximity does not preserve useful chemistry, or when decisive motifs are unreachable from all archive elites.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the online tessellation changes, occupied-cell selection probabilities depend on global score rank, accepted offspring do not obey reproducible nearest-cell assignment and strictly cell-local replacement, an incumbent outside the telemetry-only same-capacity global elite reference is removed or made ineligible solely because of its global rank, or emitted proposals cannot be traced to de novo sanitized graph edits of oracle-evaluated cell elites.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to use only the unlabeled corpus to compute a frozen robust scaling of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors and a small deterministic centroidal Voronoi tessellation, then publish only that descriptor transform, its centroids, and configuration; corpus molecules must never become an online candidate or receive scores. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load the frozen CVT, canonicalize the ten fixed observations, and retain the highest-scoring observation in each assigned cell. For every suggestion, sample occupied cells with equal probability rather than score rank, take their evaluated incumbents as parents, apply graph-fragment crossover and mutation at sampled atom, bond, ring, or fragment positions using task-agnostic chemical analogues, sanitize and canonicalize each product, and locally reject unchanged, invalid, previously evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate structures until exactly the batch size announced by init is emitted. After observe, associate each accepted score with its exact operator and parent-cell provenance, assign it to the frozen nearest-centroid cell, insert it if the cell is empty or replace only that cell's incumbent if its score is strictly higher, and leave every other cell unchanged; do not fit a surrogate, globally rank parents, globally truncate the archive, retrieve corpus candidates, or transfer labeled state between objective sessions.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain a fresh task-local CVT-MAP-Elites archive whose fixed task-agnostic descriptor cells each hold at most one oracle-evaluated molecule, choose occupied cells uniformly without global score-rank weighting, and generate every proposal de novo from their elites by sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation. Map returned offspring back through the same frozen tessellation and let each compete only with the incumbent of its own cell, so structurally distinct cell elites remain eligible to produce descendants even when they fall outside a same-capacity global top-score population.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a single globally ranked population can spend all 29 feedback rounds exploiting one early chemotype and discard lower-scoring structural stepping stones before they can yield a better descendant; the alternative archive must preserve and revisit distinct descriptor regions while sanitized graph edits still produce enough novel valid molecules to fill every batch.

applicability_conditions: Supported for the supplied unlabeled corpus: 49,668/50,000 sampled structures produced valid physicochemical descriptors, every one of the 16 fitted cells had corpus support, and one immutable transform/centroid artifact was loaded unchanged by all five objective sessions.

Supported when the initial panel and reachable edits span and revisit multiple cells: every task began in 7/16 cells, ended in 14 to 16 cells, and the adaptive run produced 41 empty-cell insertions plus 1,409 occupied-cell collisions.

Supported when within-cell oracle variation permits strict local improvement: all five tasks produced positive replacements, totaling 332 with pooled mean positive gain 0.02419137600132743, while 1,077 non-higher collisions were correctly rejected.

Supported when lower-global-rank cell elites remain useful stepping stones: every feedback snapshot contained retained outside-top-K incumbents, 226 distinct such incumbents were selected after first being observed outside top-K, and 225 contributed to later offspring.

Supported under batch size 10 and the 290-adaptive-call horizon when the graph neighborhood is productive: aggregate local novel-valid yield was 0.9647371922821024, no round needed more than 13 attempts to fill 10 proposals, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator.

The 16-cell balance is supported only on screening seed 0: final task-local coverage was 0.875 to 1.0 while enough collisions remained for local competition, and terminal Top-1 improved over the fixed initial Top-1 on all five tasks. This does not establish multi-seed stability or applicability when useful chemistry lies in one narrow niche, descriptor proximity is chemically misleading, or required motifs are unreachable by the implemented graph edits; in those settings uniform occupied-cell allocation can divert the limited oracle budget.

observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. The pre-registered same-capacity global-elitist reference retains zero incumbents outside its own top-K and therefore has zero such parent eligibility or descendant use.
observable_measurements.value: Every one of 145 archive-feedback snapshots retained at least one incumbent outside the telemetry-only same-capacity global top-K. There were 1,328 outside-top-K incumbent snapshot-incidences among 2,071 occupied-cell snapshot-incidences (fraction 0.6412361178174795), and all 1,328 were explicitly parent-eligible. Across tasks, 249 distinct task-local incumbent identities were observed outside top-K; after first entering that state, 226 were selected in 1,324 later parent draws and 225 contributed to 990 later emitted offspring (1,226 outside-elite parent links). Combined with 1.0 cell-local replacement fidelity, this shows that global rank neither truncated nor disabled those incumbents and that retained non-global elites were actively reused.

Supported when within-cell oracle variation permits strict local improvement: all five tasks produced positive replacements, totaling 332 with pooled mean positive gain 0.02419137600132743, while 1,077 non-higher collisions were correctly rejected.

Supported when lower-global-rank cell elites remain useful stepping stones: every feedback snapshot contained retained outside-top-K incumbents, 226 distinct such incumbents were selected after first being observed outside top-K, and 225 contributed to later offspring.

Supported under batch size 10 and the 290-adaptive-call horizon when the graph neighborhood is productive: aggregate local novel-valid yield was 0.9647371922821024, no round needed more than 13 attempts to fill 10 proposals, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator.

The 16-cell balance is supported only on screening seed 0: final task-local coverage was 0.875 to 1.0 while enough collisions remained for local competition, and terminal Top-1 improved over the fixed initial Top-1 on all five tasks. This does not establish multi-seed stability or applicability when useful chemistry lies in one narrow niche, descriptor proximity is chemically misleading, or required motifs are unreachable by the implemented graph edits; in those settings uniform occupied-cell allocation can divert the limited oracle budget.

activation_observables.measurement: Before every parent draw, record the complete occupied-cell set and declared probability of every eligible cell, then report the maximum absolute deviation and total-variation distance from the uniform distribution over those cells, together with aggregate realized draw counts; the registered reference is fully concentrated selection with positive deviation.

activation_observables.measurement: For every accepted scored offspring, record its assigned cell, that cell's incumbent identifier and score before feedback, the insertion or rejection decision, its incumbent after feedback, and hashes of all non-target cells; report the fraction of transitions that insert into an empty cell or replace an occupied cell if and only if the offspring score is strictly higher while leaving every other cell unchanged.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus spans enough physicochemical descriptor variation to define a stable task-agnostic CVT, and the fixed initial molecules plus generated offspring can be assigned to it without task-specific fitting.

The initial panel or early valid offspring occupy multiple cells, and subsequent edits create enough occupied-cell collisions to exercise both niche preservation and within-cell score competition during the 300-call session.
Useful high-scoring descendants are reachable by sanitized graph crossover and positional atom, bond, ring, or fragment analogue edits from oracle-evaluated archive incumbents.
Oracle scores vary within at least some cells so strict local replacement can retain improvements while lower-global-rank incumbents in other cells remain viable stepping stones.

Graph-operator validity and novelty remain high enough to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit; seed-0 evidence from node n-5a4d65146dd1 supports these emitter primitives but does not establish the CVT archive mechanism.

The fixed cell count balances coverage and reuse within 290 adaptive calls; the method may underperform when the optimum lies in one narrow niche and uniform occupied-cell allocation diverts calls, when descriptor proximity does not preserve useful chemistry, or when decisive motifs are unreachable from all archive elites.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the online tessellation changes, occupied-cell selection probabilities depend on global score rank, accepted offspring do not obey reproducible nearest-cell assignment and strictly cell-local replacement, an incumbent outside the telemetry-only same-capacity global elite reference is removed or made ineligible solely because of its global rank, or emitted proposals cannot be traced to de novo sanitized graph edits of oracle-evaluated cell elites.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to use only the unlabeled corpus to compute a frozen robust scaling of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors and a small deterministic centroidal Voronoi tessellation, then publish only that descriptor transform, its centroids, and configuration; corpus molecules must never become an online candidate or receive scores. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load the frozen CVT, canonicalize the ten fixed observations, and retain the highest-scoring observation in each assigned cell. For every suggestion, sample occupied cells with equal probability rather than score rank, take their evaluated incumbents as parents, apply graph-fragment crossover and mutation at sampled atom, bond, ring, or fragment positions using task-agnostic chemical analogues, sanitize and canonicalize each product, and locally reject unchanged, invalid, previously evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate structures until exactly the batch size announced by init is emitted. After observe, associate each accepted score with its exact operator and parent-cell provenance, assign it to the frozen nearest-centroid cell, insert it if the cell is empty or replace only that cell's incumbent if its score is strictly higher, and leave every other cell unchanged; do not fit a surrogate, globally rank parents, globally truncate the archive, retrieve corpus candidates, or transfer labeled state between objective sessions.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain a fresh task-local CVT-MAP-Elites archive whose fixed task-agnostic descriptor cells each hold at most one oracle-evaluated molecule, choose occupied cells uniformly without global score-rank weighting, and generate every proposal de novo from their elites by sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation. Map returned offspring back through the same frozen tessellation and let each compete only with the incumbent of its own cell, so structurally distinct cell elites remain eligible to produce descendants even when they fall outside a same-capacity global top-score population.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, so a single globally ranked population can spend all 29 feedback rounds exploiting one early chemotype and discard lower-scoring structural stepping stones before they can yield a better descendant; the alternative archive must preserve and revisit distinct descriptor regions while sanitized graph edits still produce enough novel valid molecules to fill every batch.
